dedupe_keys.name: habit not infrastructure replication package for truong tho living lab paper 3 metro line 1 behavioural baseline ho chi minh city

description: Ngọc Hiếu Lê publishes a behavioural and bus-stop-access baseline for Ho Chi Minh City before Metro Line 1 service. Zenodo archives versioned analysis code and public derived outputs under CC BY 4.0. The repository README links 2023 resident survey barriers to historical OpenStreetMap bus-stop access and lists coordinate-stripped analysis files, tables, figures and manuscript statistics. These derived indicators can inform public-transit demand or accessibility scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this baseline. Coverage is the Truong Tho Living Lab study area and survey period, not a citywide travel census. A limitation is that household-coordinate survey microdata are withheld under a data-use agreement, while full spatial rebuilding also needs separate OSM extracts. OpenStreetMap inputs retain ODbL terms. The deposited page calls this a replication package; the associated paper is separate and publication status is not established. No archive was downloaded, and derived statistics were not recalculated.
